item.description: Manual/local Newman acceptance flow for the EMAIL reach path. Run against a local stack; Task 5.3 will provide the Newman environment/setup that supplies {{e2eAudienceListId}} for a STATIC_LIST with at least one member. Requests inherit the collection Basic Auth variables basicAuthUsername/basicAuthPassword; override those from the Newman environment file.

exec: throw new Error('Set collection/environment variable e2eAudienceListId to a pre-seeded audience_list.id with at least one member before running the EMAIL e2e flow.');
pm.test('campaign is created as DRAFT', function () {

request.description: Creates a DRAFT EMAIL campaign for the local end-to-end reach acceptance flow.

Moves the e2e campaign through the required DRAFT to SCHEDULED lifecycle edge. SCHEDULED is the only manual edge in this flow: because the campaign startAt is set in the past, CampaignLifecycleScheduler then auto-advances SCHEDULED -> RUNNING (operators never flip RUNNING by hand), and the reach scan fires EMAIL for the now-RUNNING campaign. The next step polls metrics for that scheduler-driven result.

exec: pm.test('at least one EMAIL reach task is SENT', function () {
console.log(`SENT not observed yet; polling metrics again (${attempt}/${maxAttempts}). Pace requests with newman --delay-request ${intervalMs}ms.`);
pm.test('at least one EMAIL reach task is SENT before poll limit', function () {

request.description: Polls campaign reach metrics with an upper bound until the asynchronous EMAIL task reaches SENT. This waits for the scheduler-driven chain (auto-start SCHEDULED -> RUNNING at the past startAt, then reach scan -> dispatch -> SMTP). It is polling with a configurable interval (paced by newman --delay-request), not a one-time fixed sleep.

request.description: Reads Mailpit's local HTTP API after metrics reports SENT and asserts that the provider emitted an EMAIL whose subject includes both [Local Campaign Reach] and the dynamic {{e2eTemplateRef}}.

console.log('The assertion matches the unique e2eTemplateRef, but clearing Mailpit keeps manual reruns isolated.');
